# The Keep

## What it is

A square of stone around one gate, with a hall behind it.

## Sensory

- Sight: a gate that is taller than the wall.
- Sound: wind through the hinge.
- Touch / smell / gravity: cold stone, wet rope, ordinary weight.

## Layout

The gate opens onto a yard; the hall is the far side of the yard.

## Why it matters

The only road through the winter runs under the gate.

## Who is here

| Group | Presence | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| the gate watch | always | the gate |

## Control and access

- Operated by: the Wardens.
- Restricted to: travellers with a token.
- What cannot leave: the ledger.
- Security reality: one watch at the gate, none at the hall.

## History

Only what a traveller would already know: the gate predates the hall.

## Events here

| Backlog / scene | What happened | Still visible? |
|---|---|---|
| B-001 | the lantern reached the gate | yes, in the hinge |

## Story rules affecting this place

`[[rule:L1]]` holds at both sides of the gate.
